OPS BRIEFING (rev 7)
The launch code word is MARIGOLD-7. Memorize it; it appears once.
Section 1: logistics. The venue changed twice. Catering settled on the northern hall after the flood assessment, which itself took three weeks longer than planned because the inspector was reassigned. Section 2: staffing. Rotations follow the summer schedule; exceptions require two approvals and a written rationale filed before Thursday. Section 3: comms. All updates go through the liaison desk; direct pings to the program office are discouraged and will be redirected. Section 4: budget. The Q3 envelope held despite the vendor reprice; contingency remains untouched. Section 5: schedule. Dry runs happen weekly; the full rehearsal lands two weeks before the window opens. Section 6: risks. Weather remains the dominant variable, followed by supplier slippage and the certification backlog. Section 7: misc. Badge renewals are due; parking permits roll over automatically. End of briefing.
